title: От Луки 5 — Luke 5
instructions: Choose the correct case form of the word in brackets to fill the blank. Every option is a real form of the same word — only the case differs.

cases.sentence: И ___, столпившись вокруг него, слушал Слово Божие.
cases.translation: …and the crowd, pressing around him, was listening to the word of God.
cases.explain: Народ is the subject of слушал (was listening), so it stays in the nominative — the dictionary form.

cases.translation: He got into one of the boats.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of/from among) takes the genitive; лодок is the genitive plural of лодка.

cases.sentence: Он сказал ___, «Отплыви на глубокое место и закинь сети для лова».
cases.translation: He said to Simon, “Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch.”
cases.explain: Сказать кому? — “to say to someone” — governs the dative, so Симону is required.

cases.sentence: Я пришел призвать к покаянию не праведников, а ___.
cases.translation: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.
cases.explain: Грешников is the direct object of призвать (to call); since it is an animate plural noun, the accusative takes the same form as the genitive.

cases.translation: They were reclining together with Jesus.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with, meaning “together with”) takes the instrumental — Иисусом.

cases.sentence: Иисус обедает с грешниками в ___ Левия.
cases.translation: Jesus dines with sinners in the house of Levi.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) marking location, with no motion involved, takes the prepositional case — доме.

cases.translation: …and asked him to put out a little from the shore.
cases.explain: The preposition от (away from) always takes the genitive — берега.

reading.ru: Однажды Иисус стоял у Генесаретского озера, и народ, столпившись вокруг него, слушал Слово Божие.
reading.question: Where was Jesus standing when the crowd pressed around him to hear the word of God?
reading.explain: The chapter opens with Jesus standing by the Lake of Gennesaret while the crowd listened to the word of God.

reading.ru: Когда Симон Петр это увидел, он пал к ногам Иисуса и сказал, «Уйди от меня, Господи, ведь я человек грешный».
reading.question: What did Simon Peter say to Jesus after the miraculous catch of fish?
options: "Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!"
reading.correct: "Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!"
reading.explain: Overwhelmed by the huge catch, Simon Peter fell at Jesus' feet and said, 'Go away from me, Lord; I am a sinful man!'

reading.ru: Иисус же сказал Симону, «Не бойся, отныне ты будешь ловить людей».
reading.question: What did Jesus tell Simon he would do from now on?
options: Catch people (be a fisher of men)
reading.correct: Catch people (be a fisher of men)
reading.explain: Jesus told Simon, 'Don't be afraid. From now on you will be catching people.'

reading.ru: Когда он увидел Иисуса, то пал на лицо свое и стал умолять его, «Господи, если ты захочешь, ты можешь меня очистить».
reading.question: What did the man with leprosy ask Jesus to do?
reading.explain: The leprous man fell on his face and begged Jesus, 'Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.'

reading.ru: Так твое исцеление будет удостоверено перед людьми».
reading.question: Why did Jesus tell the healed leper to show himself to the priest and offer the sacrifice Moses commanded?
options: As a testimony/proof of his healing before the people
Because Jesus could not heal him fully otherwise
To pay a fine for having had leprosy
Because the priest would decide whether to heal him
reading.correct: As a testimony/proof of his healing before the people
reading.explain: Jesus said the offering would serve so that his healing would be certified/attested before the people.

reading.ru: С Иисусом была сила Господа, чтобы исцелять больных, и тут пришли несколько человек, неся на циновке парализованного, и пытались внести его в дом, чтобы положить перед Иисусом.
reading.question: Why were the men carrying a paralyzed man on a mat trying to bring him to Jesus?
options: So Jesus could heal him with the power of the Lord that was with him
To have him join the Pharisees
reading.correct: So Jesus could heal him with the power of the Lord that was with him
reading.explain: The text says the power of the Lord was with Jesus to heal the sick, and men brought the paralyzed man to be laid before him.

reading.ru: Когда Иисус увидел их веру, Он сказал больному, «Друг, прощаются тебе твои грехи».
reading.question: What did Jesus first say to the paralyzed man before healing his body?
reading.explain: Seeing their faith, Jesus first said to the paralyzed man, 'Friend, your sins are forgiven.'

reading.question: What did Jesus say to Levi the tax collector when he saw him at the tax booth?
reading.explain: Jesus said to Levi, 'Follow me,' and Levi got up, left everything, and followed him.

reading.ru: Иисус ответил им, «Не здоровым нужен врач, а больным. Я пришел призвать к покаянию не праведников, а грешников».
reading.question: How did Jesus explain why he ate with tax collectors and sinners?
options: He compared himself to a physician who is needed by the sick, not the healthy
He said the law required it
He said the tax collectors had paid him
He said the Pharisees had invited him
reading.correct: He compared himself to a physician who is needed by the sick, not the healthy
reading.explain: Jesus answered, 'It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick... I have come to call not the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.'

reading.ru: Но наступит время, когда жених будет взят от них.
reading.question: According to Jesus, when will his disciples fast?
options: After the bridegroom is taken away from them
reading.correct: After the bridegroom is taken away from them
reading.explain: Jesus said that when the bridegroom is taken away from them, then, in those days, they will fast.

reading.ru: И никто, пьющий старое вино, не захочет молодого, потому что скажет, старое лучше.
reading.question: In the parable about wine, why does no one who has drunk old wine want new wine right away?
options: Because he says the old wine is better
Because new wine is too expensive
Because old wine is forbidden by law
reading.correct: Because he says the old wine is better
reading.explain: The chapter ends with the saying that no one who has drunk old wine immediately wants new, for he says, 'The old is better.'
